findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hsh-web-scrape, hsh-monitoring · Private data: hsh-b2b-contact, hsh-b2b-enriched, hsh-b2b-full, hsh-web-scrape, hsh-monitoring, hsh-india-announcements, hsh-india-fundamentals, hsh-cricket-fantasy-picks, hsh-cricket-matchup, hsh-cricket-chase-difficulty · Public sink: hsh-b2b-contact, hsh-monitoring, hsh-india-fundamentals, hsh-mena-intel, hsh-cricket-fantasy-picks, hsh-cricket-chase-winprob, hsh-cricket-parscore, hsh-cricket-timeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hsh-web-scrape, hsh-monitoring · Private data: hsh-b2b-contact, hsh-b2b-enriched, hsh-b2b-full, hsh-web-scrape, hsh-monitoring, hsh-india-announcements, hsh-india-fundamentals, hsh-cricket-fantasy-picks, hsh-cricket-matchup, hsh-cricket-chase-difficulty · Public sink: hsh-b2b-contact, hsh-monitoring, hsh-india-fundamentals, hsh-mena-intel, hsh-cricket-fantasy-picks, hsh-cricket-chase-winprob, hsh-cricket-parscore, hsh-cricket-timeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
